name: Dual VC Dimension / Log Size Ratio (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the universal class $\mathcal U_n$, $\mathrm{VC}^*=n$, while the log size ratio is $\log(n-1)/\log(2^n+1)=o(1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, the log size ratio is $\log(2^n-1)/\log(n+1)=\Theta(n/\log n)$, while $\mathrm{VC}^*=\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$.
proof: The universal-class and full-cube value calculations give gaps whose ratios diverge in the two opposite directions.
references: Database-owned value proofs; the dual-VC values also follow from \cite{chornomaz2025spherical}.
